prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **All Star Karate** in St. Peters. It offers children’s Isshinryu karate classes in a structured, encouraging setting, with an emphasis on confidence, discipline, respect, and self-defense. [All Star Karate](https://allstarkarate.com/)

If you’re open to Brazilian jiu-jitsu instead, **Onyx Grappling** offers age-grouped children’s classes, including for ages 4–6 and 7–9, as well as kids and teen classes. [Onyx Grappling](https://onyxgrappling.com/)

I’d visit or try a class at both before enrolling. Watch how instructors handle beginners, whether kids seem engaged and safe, and ask about trial classes, total fees, and contract terms.
